7. ORDINANCES
A. Introduction for First Reading an Ordinance on Water Neutrality
Recommended Action
Staff r ecommend s that the City Council introduce for first reading the attached Water N eutrality ordinance that requires new developments and new or enlarged pools, spas, water features, and ponds to stay within the same water use as the existing property through the installation of water-efficient fixtures and systems on-site. If compliance cannot be met, the applicant must offset the projected additional water use elsewhere in the city. The City will provide a fee-based turn-key retrofit program and/ or the applicant can install retrofits at self-selected sites at their own cost.
